prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a hit while turning left in League City, Texas, and has wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1241; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather not give my full name on a recording, but you can note that I was the driver of the vehicle involved.
Q: That's fine. Can you describe where the collision happened?
A: It was at an intersection in League City, Texas. I was making a left turn across the oncoming lanes.
Q: What were the conditions like when you started the turn?
A: It was daylight and the road was dry. Traffic in the opposite direction had a green light, I think, but I was waiting for a gap.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle before you began turning?
A: I saw headlights a ways off. I judged that I had time to get through, and I started moving.
Q: Where did the impact occur relative to your vehicle?
A: The other car struck the front passenger side of mine as I was crossing into the lane.
Q: Were you wearing a seatbelt?
A: Yes, I was.
Q: Have you received medical treatment since the collision?
A: Yes. I was taken to an urgent care clinic that evening. They found that my wrist was fractured, and I've been wearing a splint and going to follow-up appointments.
Q: Did you have any injuries to other parts of your body?
A: I had some soreness in my neck and shoulder, but the wrist is the main problem right now.
Q: Is there anything you would like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I'm cooperating fully and I'll provide any records you need from my doctor.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
